svg.title: Market Ecology Simulator — world view
svg.desc: An isometric model city. The exchange tower stands at the centre, surrounded by districts: a dense momentum quarter, a quiet value quarter, an ETF depot, a leveraged fund tower, the central bank and a noise trader suburb. Streets carry order flow into the exchange. Side panels list the districts and the trace of one selected agent.
svg.text: WORLD VIEW · ONE MARKET, SIX DISTRICTS · SEED 42
Central bank signals rate cut · fair +1.2%
sets the fair value everyone argues about
liquidity for no reason at all
lit blocks run momentum, dark blocks value
one margin call from the street
buys on a timer, at any price
lean in, so I lean in."
no view on fair value · equity 49 296
ONE FIGURE = 10 AGENTS · LIT WINDOWS = CAPITAL AT WORK · BEAD SIZE = ORDER SIZE
SPACE PAUSE · ] STEP · DRAG TO ORBIT
